snippet.title: EVERSPACE 2 | Galactic Edition — Switch 2 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Performance note: The Nintendo Switch 2 version of EVERSPACE 2: Galactic Edition is capped at 30 FPS. This trailer is presented at 60 FPS using our standard trailer production workflow.

Experience all of EVERSPACE 2 in one package with the EVERSPACE 2: Galactic Edition on Switch 2. This bundle collects all purchasable EVERSPACE 2 game content into one easy purchase. 

EVERSPACE 2
Experience a 30 hour adventure in this fast-paced single-player spaceship shooter with exploration in space and on planets, tons of loot, RPG elements, mining, and crafting. Explore an exciting sci-fi story set in a vivid, handcrafted open world full of secrets, puzzles, and perils.      

EVERSPACE 2: Titans
The Dreadnought and Leviathan have arrived in Cluster 34. Collect new weapon and gear sets by tackling massive repeatable challenges. Discover two exciting storylines alongside a cast of new and returning characters! 

EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients
The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, and the path of destruction leads to the Okkar Homeworlds. Take flight in this massive expansion containing a post-game storyline, exciting side quests, four new star systems, new weapons and gear, and the Wraith starfighter.

EVERSPACE 2: Supporter Pack
The EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack opens up new cosmetic options for series megafans to customize ships. Contains more than 50 customizable additions including adjustable ship skins, decals, engine and thruster effects, and cybernetic glow lighting options.

Dive in on Switch 2: https://nintendo.com/us/store/products/everspace-2-galactic-edition-switch-2
Available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53820/EVERSPACE_2_Galactic_Edition/
Get it on GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/everspace_2_galactic_edition
Out Now on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1562-PPSA15671_00-0598948097523306
Play on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/everspace-2-galactic-edition/9nwm072lfbn3

Follow us on: 
https://www.facebook.com/everspace.game
https://bsky.app/profile/everspace.game
https://twitter.com/everspace_game 
https://www.instagram.com/everspace_game/
https://www.reddit.com/r/EverspaceGame/ 
http://discord.gg/rockfishgames

Music used in and officially licensed for the trailer through positionmusic.com: "Global Down" by Kings & Creatures & Sergey Azbel.

This project is partially made possible through funding from the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action of Germany.
